endings.name: Marth
endings.title: Prince of Altea
endings.text: He returned to the wartorn Altea and worked to restore his homeland. He is expected to soon ascend the throne.

endings.name: Caeda
endings.title: Princess of Talys
endings.text: After returning to Talys, she headed to Altea, where rumors of a passionate relationship between her and Prince Marth began to circulate.

endings.name: Jagen
endings.title: Marth's Guardian
endings.text: He retired from active duty and became a trusted advisor to Prince Marth.

endings.name: Cain
endings.title: Knight of Altea
endings.text: He remained with the Altean Knights and dedicated himself to mentoring the new recruits.

endings.name: Abel
endings.title: Knight of Altea
endings.text: He retired from the army to start a small shop. Recently there have been rumours of his upcoming wedding...

altEndings.title: Knight of Altea
altEndings.text: Due to the grief of losing Est, he left Altea. His whereabouts after that are unknown.

endings.name: Draug
endings.title: Knight of Altea
endings.text: He remained in the army and guarded the border. He gained 10 kilograms.

endings.name: Gordin
endings.title: Archer of Altea
endings.text: He became the apprentice of a bow knight in Archanea, and later rejoined the Altean army along with his younger brother.

endings.name: Ogma
endings.title: Talys Mercenary
endings.text: He returned to Talys island to help the citizens. Is there someone he idolizes? There are no rumours of marriage.

endings.name: Bord
endings.title: Talys Volunteer
endings.text: In the Kingdom of Talys he lived peacefully as a woodcutter.

endings.name: Cord
endings.title: Talys Volunteer
endings.text: In the Kingdom of Talys he lived peacefully as a woodcutter.

endings.name: Barst
endings.title: Talys Volunteer
endings.text: He joined the Archanean army, but later abandoned his post. It is rumoured that he became a pirate...

endings.name: Castor
endings.title: Hunter of Talys
endings.text: He returned to Talys to live with his mother. However, his life is harsh.

endings.name: Lena
endings.title: Saint of the Frontier
endings.text: At a monastery in Macedon she cared for orphans.

endings.name: Julian
endings.title: Flirtatious Thief
endings.text: He gave up thievery and worked in Macedon.

altEndings.title: Reformed Thief
altEndings.text: He continued his beloved Lena's will and cared for orphans.

endings.name: Navarre
endings.title: Mysterious Sellsword
endings.text: Despite others' expectations, he left like the wind.

endings.name: Merric
endings.title: Mage of Altea
endings.text: He returned to Khadein once again, his feelings for Princess Elice hidden in his heart.

endings.name: Hardin
endings.title: Prince of Aurelis
endings.text: He married Princess Nyna, and became the 24th King of Archanea.

endings.name: Wolf
endings.title: Warrior of Aurelis
endings.text: He remained with the Aurelis Knights, and devoted himself to the country's reconstruction.

endings.name: Sedgar
endings.title: Warrior of Aurelis
endings.text: He remained with the Aurelis Knights, and devoted himself to the country's reconstruction.

endings.name: Roshea
endings.title: Warrior of Aurelis
endings.text: He retired from the army, but later returned and became a Paladin of Aurelis.

endings.name: Vyland
endings.title: Warrior of Aurelis
endings.text: He remained with the Aurelis Knights, and devoted himself to the country's reconstruction.

endings.name: Matthis
endings.title: Macedonian Nobleman
endings.text: He retired from the army and lived his carefree life in Macedon.

endings.name: Wendell
endings.title: Bishop of Khadein
endings.text: He became the Pontifex of Khadein, and then set out on a journey, wandering across many countries.

endings.name: Rickard
endings.title: Julian's Bro
endings.text: It seems he returned to thievery again.

endings.name: Bantu
endings.title: Fire Dragon Guardian
endings.text: After sealing his dragonstone he left for whereabouts unknown.

endings.name: Caesar
endings.title: Warren Mercenary
endings.text: After the war, he vanished without a trace.

endings.name: Radd
endings.title: Caesar's Partner
endings.text: It is said that he fell in love during the war and then laid down his sword.

endings.name: Catria
endings.title: Knight of Macedon
endings.text: She devoted herself to the restoration of Macedon.

altEndings.title: Middle Pegasus Knight
altEndings.text: Mourning the death of her older sister Palla, she dedicated herself to the restoration of Macedon.

endings.name: Palla
endings.title: Macedonian Knight
endings.text: With complicated feelings in her heart, she worked to rebuild her homeland.

endings.name: Minerva
endings.title: Princess of Macedon
endings.text: She put all her strength into restoring Macedon. There are rumours that she will succeed the throne... but she denies them.

endings.name: Maria
endings.title: Minerva's Sister
endings.text: She studied in Khadein and then returned to Macedon and served her people as a cleric.

endings.name: Linde
endings.title: Miloah's Daughter
endings.text: Under Nyna's protection she became a court lady of Pales.

endings.name: Jeorge
endings.title: Greatest Archer
endings.text: He became the captain of the Archanean bow knights.

endings.name: Midia
endings.title: Knight of Archanea
endings.text: At Princess Nyna's request, she remained in the army and became the captain of the Archanean knights.

endings.name: Boah
endings.title: Bishop of Archanea
endings.text: As the court bishop of Archanea, he devoted himself to the restoration of the country.

endings.name: Dolph
endings.title: Knight of Archanea
endings.text: He became a general, but later retired from the army.

endings.name: Macelan
endings.title: Archanean Knight
endings.text: After the war, he retired from the army with Dolph.

endings.name: Tomas
endings.title: Archanean Archer
endings.text: After the war he disappeared.

endings.name: Astram of Archanea
endings.text: As the captain of the Archanean mercenaries he devoted himself to his country. Recently, there have been rumors of his upcoming wedding...

endings.name: Xane
endings.title: Mysterious Stranger
endings.text: After the war he left without saying a word.

endings.name: Arran
endings.title: Wayward Paladin
endings.text: At Jagen's request, he became captain of the Altean Knights.

endings.name: Samson
endings.title: Moody Hero
endings.text: After the war, he returned to his mercenary career.

endings.name: Tiki
endings.title: Divine Dragon Princess
endings.text: By Bantu's side she quietly passed her days.

endings.name: Est
endings.title: Carefree Pegasus Knight
endings.text: During the war, she fell in love with an Altean knight and refused to leave his side.

altEndings.title: Youngest Pegasus Knight
altEndings.text: Unable to bear the loss of Abel, she vanished after the war.

endings.name: Lorenz
endings.title: Unlucky General
endings.text: He appointed the Prince of Grust and entrusted him with governing. He later came into conflict with Archanea and was exiled.

endings.name: Elice
endings.title: Princess of Altea
endings.text: She lived peacefully, watching over Prince Marth.

endings.name: Marth
endings.title: Prince of Altea
endings.text: He became the 5th King of Altea and, as the leader of the Unified Kingdom of Archanea, worked tirelessly to restore the devastated nations.

endings.name: Caeda
endings.title: Marth's Fiancee
endings.text: After the war, her long-awaited dream was realized, as the day of her wedding with Marth came. In her pure white dress, she was as beautiful as an angel. For Fer it was a joyous day that she would never forget as long as she lived.

endings.name: Cecil
endings.title: Kntight of Altea
endings.text: She remained within the royal knights to care for those who had been displaced by the war. Later, she served as a Paladin of Altea, and remained loyal to the Altean royal family to the very end.

endings.name: Cain
endings.title: Knight of Altea
endings.text: He became the leader of Altea's knights. After Jagen's death, he became Marth's most trusted subordinate.

endings.name: Abel
endings.title: Knight of Altea
endings.text: After the war, he left the country to search for Est, who had disappeared. His whereabouts after that are unknown.

altEndings.title: Knight of Altea
altEndings.text: Due to the grief of losing Est, he left Altea. His whereabouts after that are unknown.

endings.name: Draug
endings.title: Knight of Altea
endings.text: Under Marth's orders, he became the captain of the Grustian guard.

endings.name: Gordin
endings.title: Archer of Altea
endings.text: For some reason, he left the Altean knights for Pales in Archanea. Later, he joined Archanea's free knights.

endings.name: Ogma
endings.title: Mercenary of Talys
endings.text: After the war he vanished.

endings.name: Luke
endings.title: Knight of Altea
endings.text: He left the knights, and once again became a carefree vagabond.

endings.name: Rodrick
endings.title: Knight of Altea
endings.text: He remained within the knights and worked under Marth. Later he became one of the continent's most renowned Paladins.

endings.name: Ryan
endings.title: Archer of Altea
endings.text: He remained in Altea, and joined the Temple Knights.

endings.name: Castor
endings.title: Talysian Swindler
endings.text: He joined the Archanean free knights and later returned to Talys to live with his mother. He saved up quite a bit of money...

endings.name: Lena
endings.title: Bishop of Macedon
endings.text: At a monastery in Macedon she cared for orphans.

endings.name: Julian
endings.title: Honest Thief
endings.text: Together with Lena he cared for orphans at a monastery in Macedon.

altEndings.title: Reformed Thief
altEndings.text: He continued his beloved Lena's will and cared for orphans.

endings.name: Navarre
endings.title: Scarlet Swordsman
endings.text: He ignored others' expecations, and once again left like the wind.

endings.name: Merric
endings.title: the Wind Mage
endings.text: He established a magic academy in Pales and taught the youth.

endings.name: Jubelo
endings.title: Prince of Grust
endings.text: Under the guardianship of King Marth, he pursued his studies in Altea.

endings.name: Yuliya
endings.title: Grustian Princess
endings.text: She studied in the magic academy of Pales. She aspired to become a cleric.

endings.name: Marisha
endings.title: Girl from Grust
endings.text: After the war she vanished without a trace, much to Marth's worry. Perhaps she became a delinquent...

endings.name: Roshea
endings.title: Knight of Aurelis
endings.text: After the war he departed to Aurelis, perhaps to mourn Hardin...

endings.name: Warren
endings.title: Hunter of Macedon
endings.text: He returned to Macedon, and became a hunter once more.

endings.name: Matthis
endings.title: Lena's Foolish Brother
endings.text: He lived in Macedon, living his usual carefree life.

endings.name: Wendell
endings.title: Pontifex of Khadein
endings.text: He returned to Khadein as its pontifex and worked tirelessly to restore the magic city.

endings.name: Rickard
endings.title: Julian's bro
endings.text: It seems he returned to thievery once again. He never learns...

endings.name: Bantu
endings.title: Tiki's Guardian
endings.text: He discarded his dragonstone, and left for parts unknown.

endings.name: Samuel
endings.title: Careless Mercenary
endings.text: After the war he vanished. It is rumoured that he still uses Navarre's name...

altEndings.title: Careless Mercenary
altEndings.text: He trained his sword to inherit the fame of the fallen Navarre.

endings.name: Arlen
endings.title: mage of Khadein
endings.text: He became a High Bishop of Khadein, and worked to restore the magic city.

endings.name: Catria
endings.title: Knight of Macedon
endings.text: Being considerate of her older sister, she worked tirelessly to restore Macedon.

altEndings.title: Middle Pegasus Knight
altEndings.text: Mourning the death of her older sister Palla, she dedicated herself to the restoration of Macedon.

endings.name: Palla
endings.title: Knight of Macedon
endings.text: With complex emotions hidden in her heart, she worked diligently and tirelessly.

endings.name: Minerva
endings.title: Princess of Macedon
endings.text: She renounced the Macedonian throne to work at Lena's monastery.

endings.name: Maria
endings.title: Minerva's Sister
endings.text: At Lena's monastery she cared for orphans.

endings.name: Linde
endings.title: Mage of Light
endings.text: She worked at the magic academy in Pales. Perhaps she has fallen in love, as she has become more beautiful recently.

endings.name: Jeorge
endings.title: Greatest Archer
endings.text: After the war, he formed the Archanean Free Knights to protect people from bandits.

endings.name: Midia
endings.title: Knight of Archanea
endings.text: She joined the Archanean free knights, to serve her people.

endings.name: Nyna
endings.title: Princess of Archanea
endings.text: After the war, she entrusted all of Archanea to Marth and disappeared...

endings.name: Phina
endings.title: Travelling Dancer
endings.text: After the war, she too departed like the wind.

endings.name: Sheena
endings.title: Princess of Gra
endings.text: Refusing Marth's request, she abdicated the trone of Gra, and returned to Pales. Now she lives as an ordinary girl.

endings.name: Sirius
endings.title: Masked Knight
endings.text: After the war he vanished without speaking a word...

endings.name: Astram
endings.title: Mercenary of Archanea
endings.text: He joined the Archanean Free Knights and worked for the people. He recently got married...

endings.name: Xane
endings.title: Divine Dragon Youth
endings.text: After the war he once again vanished without a trace.

endings.name: Arran
endings.title: the Ill Paladin
endings.text: After the war ended he died of illness...

endings.name: Samson
endings.title: Sheena's Hero
endings.text: After the war he settled down in Pales...

endings.name: Tiki
endings.title: Divine Dragon Princess
endings.text: She lived happily in Pales, surrounded by her friends.

endings.name: Est
endings.title: Wayward Knight
endings.text: After the war, she bade Abel farewell for reasons unknown and vanished.

altEndings.title: Youngest Pegasus Knight
altEndings.text: Unable to bear the loss of Abel, she vanished after the war.

endings.name: Elice
endings.title: Princess of Altea
endings.text: She assisted with the establishment of the magic academy in Pales. Later she married, and passed her days happily.
